import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["rate_feed"].copy()

    # Preserve cursor ordering semantics: ORDER BY account_id, obs_date, obs_seq
    df = df.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "obs_date", "obs_seq"],
        kind="mergesort"  # stable sort to preserve input order on ties
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Forward-fill rate within each account only (never crosses account boundary)
    df["rate_filled"] = df.groupby("account_id", sort=False)["rate"].ffill()

    # carried = 1 only when original rate was NULL and a prior rate existed to carry
    df["was_carried"] = (
        (df["rate"].isna()) & (df["rate_filled"].notna())
    ).astype(int)

    result = df[["account_id", "obs_seq", "obs_date", "rate_filled", "was_carried"]].copy()

    return {"rate_filled": result}
